caption: The drawing shows three labeled views of a single object and one detailed section of its design, rendered primarily in shades of brown, orange, and beige. On the left, there is a side view featuring a tall and slender vertical wooden post with turned elements, and a square base. In the center, the front view displays the same post, which here supports a broad, flat, rectangular structure at the bottom with vertical parallel lines suggesting slats or strings, and decorative woodwork on each side. Above this is an angled, tapered section that connects back to the post. The rightmost inset is marked as a "Detail of Design" and depicts a vertical elongated rectangle containing decorative geometric and wavy patterns, primarily linear with sections of crosshatching. The drawings are made with fine lines and shaded with a watercolor effect, focusing on structure and pattern. Labels are written in small, simple handwriting. The composition is arranged within a bordered central square on a larger cream-colored page.
title: Hand Loom
